Agent: You're welcome! I'm glad to hear that you've already enjoyed some of the examples. Before We Were Yours and Westworld are both excellent works that use flashbacks and backstories to develop characters and provide context for their actions. I hope you enjoy them!
User: I think I'll go with the Samsung Galaxy Fit. I like the modern design and the full-color display sounds really appealing. Plus, the advanced features like stress tracking and VO2 max estimation sound interesting. Thanks for the recommendation!
User: Thanks for letting me know, but can you suggest any reliable sports analytics websites where I can find such information about Freddie Freeman's performance this season?
User: That's really cool! I love finding souvenirs that are unique and support local artists. Have you ever bought a souvenir just because it was so weird or out-of-the-box?
